terrainDescription.zh: 北部為北德平原，中部為丘陵與森林地形（如黑森林），南部近阿爾卑斯山脈邊緣多山地。
terrainDescription.en: The North German Plain dominates the north, central Germany is hilly and forested (e.g. the Black Forest), and the south turns mountainous near the edge of the Alps.

plate.color: white background, black text, blue EU band with "D" + district/city code letters

roadInfra.bollardStyle: Flat black-and-white bollards with white/light-grey reflectors (orange near intersections), 2 screws/bolts on the reflector (vs. Luxembourg's near-identical style with 3); some carry small blue side plates with road numbers

utilityPole.transformerMount: Wide variety of pole-top styles — horizontal bar with uneven hanging insulators, triangle tops, and T-shaped tops are most common; wooden poles often carry a rectangular white sticker; black/dark-grey sign backs are notably common (rare elsewhere in Europe)

historicalContext.zh: 德語使用拉丁字母並保留 ä、ö、ü、ß 等特殊字母，是德、奧、瑞士（德語區）共通的書寫特徵，路牌招牌上常見這些變音符號。
historicalContext.en: German uses the Latin alphabet but retains distinctive letters (ä, ö, ü, ß) shared with Austria and German-speaking Switzerland — a recurring giveaway on signage across all three.
